gen-modak-montserrat: Puffy, bouncy lettering with enormous lowercase eyes, Modak leaves every curve far from closing up. Montserrat, the sans-serif body, gives each curve plenty of white space around it.
gen-montserrat-fs-karma: Montserrat is cut like an engraver's line, one depth throughout, wide-mouthed and crisp. And Karma, a serif with a soft step from heavy to light, carries paragraphs smoothly without snagging the eye.
gen-mystery-quest-fs-karma: Nostalgic and bookish, Mystery Quest has open jaws on every curve. Karma, the serif body, has a gentle modulation that never snags the eye, so paragraphs move along comfortably.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-port-lligat-slab: Storybook letters with open-jawed curves and compact ascenders, courtesy of Mystery Quest. Port Lligat Slab brings lowercase counters like wide glass portholes, which is the pair's single best quality.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-savate: Savate reads crisp and contemporary, with a rounded o nearly matching its capital. Beneath the bookish Mystery Quest heading, that sans-serif body moves along smoothly, its hairlines sturdy enough for line after line.
gen-nixie-one-dm-sans: The body text feels friendly and open, with the terminals on its s spread well apart. DM Sans can afford a slightly larger size beneath the nostalgic, constant-stroke Nixie One heading.
gen-nixie-one-fs-bespoke-sans: Retro-tech, nostalgic lettering: Nixie One makes its horizontal bars exactly match its upright stems in weight. Bespoke Sans stays sharp beside it, with generous space at its curve ends.
gen-nixie-one-fs-spline-sans: A constant stroke from top to baseline defines Nixie One, its curves left open with clear gaps. Spline Sans, with vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight, keeps long text flowing smoothly.
gen-nixie-one-gf-actor: Stitched-thread strokes with a nostalgic, retro-tech feel. Nixie One's plain outlines give way to Actor, whose wide s curves barely curl in, for a clean, modern body text.
gen-nixie-one-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is monoline and precise, keeping its curve endings well apart. But Nixie One, nostalgic and retro-tech up top, shares that single-weight line, which is what ties the two together.
